jobInfo.jobTitle: Paraprofessional (Primary School - grades PreK-2nd) with great benefits LOOK
jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
There are open paraprofessional position at the Lunenburg Primary School to support students in preschool through 2nd grade.

Lunenburg Primary School (grades PreK-2nd)
1401 Massachusetts Avenue, Lunenburg, MA  01462

GENERAL
This position will provide student support in the area of academics, along with social and emotional behavior regulation.
The ideal candidate should be energetic, motivated individual to work with collaboratively with co-workers and teachers.
This is a school-year position--32.5 hours per week.

REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
The successful candidate will possess knowledge/experience working with early childhood students with social/ emotional and academic needs.
Experience working with young children is required.
Experience working with young children in a school setting is preferred.    

OTHER
Salary and benefits per Lunenburg Paraprofessionals Agreement.
Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.

•9 paid holidays, paid sick leave and personal leave
•Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (75% employer, 25% employee)
•Tuition Reimbursement (up to $600 per undergraduate class, up to $900 per graduate class)
•Career Advancement and Professional Development
